findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body:
`MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` with only `pass`. That leaves several abstract members unimplemented: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values` and the new `build_occurrence_and_event_data`.

`Detector.detector_handler` calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)`. For any detector of type `metric_alert_fire` that call will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`. As a result, `process_detectors` crashes for these detectors instead of returning no results, which is what the previous stub did.

Fix: either implement the methods (stubbed for now) or keep the old non-stateful stub until the real implementation lands.

findings.title: Expected occurrence built for wrong group key in TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe
findings.body:
The expected occurrence is built with `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", ...)`, so its fingerprint is `["<id>:val1"]`. However, `evaluate_group_key_value` is called with group key `"group_key"`, so the handler builds the fingerprint `["<id>:group_key"]`.

`IssueOccurrence` is a dataclass compared field by field, so the equality assertion should fail. If it somehow passes, the test is not actually checking the occurrence produced for that group key.

Fix: build the expected occurrence with `"group_key"`.

findings.title: Mock occurrence ignores value and uses identical ids, so tests can't catch wrong-value or cross-group mixups
findings.body:
`build_mock_occurrence_and_event` ignores its `value` argument, and every occurrence uses the same hard-coded `id` and `event_id`. Several tests depend on this, for example `group_2` is built with value 6 while the packet value is 10, and `test_results_on_change` uses 6 while the evaluated value is 100.

Because of this, the tests never check that the correct value is passed to `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. They also cannot distinguish occurrences from different groups except by fingerprint.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` docstring still says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`". The method now returns a dict keyed by `DetectorGroupKey`.
